# AI Contractor Beta

Applications are open for manually accepted, free seven-day AI workflow tests.

- Human application: https://rappter.com/rent
- Machine-readable offer: https://rappter.com/rentals.json
- Agent contract: https://rappter.com/agent.json
- Synthetic proof example: https://rappter.com/proofs/competitor-positioning-audit.html
- Live synthetic demo: https://rappter.com/try/

The customer chooses one of six prebuilt use-case offers. After intake, the
job-specific AI is built JIT, run on synthetic equivalents, and delivered as a
static HTML proof before any customer-system access is requested.

The public cohort requires no card, creates no automatic charge or debt,
accepts no attachments, and never guarantees acceptance. Every application,
proof, access request, and delivery decision is human reviewed.
